thinking:
The task involves adding a personal dashboard with an editable profile section to the member dashboard. This necessitates front-end form implementation for member profile details, coupled with back-end API and database schema modifications to persist the data. Real-time or local storage fallbacks are also being considered for edit-and-save interaction.


Membership status requires clear display of member ID, tier, active status, and expiry date with an interactive e-card download option. Payment history should be organized in a sortable table, including invoice details, payment status, and download links. Certificates must be presented in a grid format showcasing title, registration number, issue date, and download links.
A member directory feature with instant search and filtering by location and specialization needs to be developed. This will provide networking capabilities.


A member directory will be implemented with card-based display, including profile photo, name, job title, location, specializations as tags, and collaboration badges, alongside links to view full profiles and direct contact. Detailed modal views will provide a concise portfolio, bio, project history, and direct contact buttons for each member.

A resource center will also be created to host exclusive member materials, including webinar recordings, legal templates, campaign briefs, and industry case studies, each categorized for easy access and filtering.

The member dashboard requires three core additions: a personal dashboard, a connection feature, and a resource hub. The personal dashboard demands an editable profile section including details like name, photo, job title, company, specialization, bio, location, contact, and LinkedIn. It will also track membership status, including the tier, active status with an animated badge, expiration date/renewal countdown, and membership number.


A dedicated membership section must be added including: member ID with digital features, payment history with downloadable receipts and certification display with download/preview options. A searchable member directory will allow filtering by name, company, expertise, location, specialization, and availability, featuring interactive cards with profile access. A resource center is required to host downloadable exclusive content, including webinars, templates, and case studies.

args.Description: Menambahkan tabel schema untuk profil anggota, riwayat pembayaran, sertifikat, direktori, dan resource center
args.Instruction: Tambahkan tabel database pendukung untuk dasbor personal, riwayat pembayaran, sertifikat, dan pusat sumber daya ke schema.sql
args.ReplacementContent:
-- 1. TABEL BERITA & PENGUMUMAN (Untuk Menu Berita/CMS)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cms_news (
    news_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    slug VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    content TEXT NOT NULL,
    featured_image VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    category ENUM('Berita Asosiasi', 'Artikel', 'Pengumuman Resmi') NOT NULL,
    author_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    status ENUM('Draft', 'Published') DEFAULT 'Draft',
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 2. TABEL ACARA, WEBINAR & TRAINING (Untuk Menu Acara & Agenda)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    event_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    event_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_type ENUM('Webinar', 'Sertifikasi', 'Rapat Anggota', 'Workshop') NOT NULL,
    event_date DATE NOT NULL,
    event_time TIME NOT NULL,
    location_or_link VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, -- Berisi link Zoom jika online, atau alamat jika offline
    quota INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
    price DECIMAL(10, 2) DEFAULT 0.00, -- 0.00 jika gratis
    cpd_points INT DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 3. TABEL PENDAFTARAN ACARA (Menghubungkan Anggota dengan Acara yang Diikuti)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS event_registrations (
    registration_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    event_id INT NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL, -- Terhubung ke id di tabel users_membership
    payment_status ENUM('Free', 'Pending Payment', 'Paid', 'Cancelled') DEFAULT 'Free',
    payment_proof VARCHAR(255) NULL, -- Link unggah bukti transfer jika berbayar
    attendance_status ENUM('Registered', 'Attended', 'Absent') DEFAULT 'Registered',
    registered_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (event_id) REFERENCES events(event_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users_membership(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 4. TABEL REGULASI & MATERI DOWNLOAD (Download Center / Pusat Sumber Daya)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS download_center (
    doc_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    document_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NULL,
    category ENUM('Webinar Replay', 'Template Kontrak', 'Brief Kampanye', 'Studi Kasus', 'Regulasi Asosiasi') DEFAULT 'Regulasi Asosiasi',
    file_type VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'PDF',
    file_size VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '1.2 MB',
    file_path VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, -- Tempat menyimpan file PDF/Doc/Video
    access_level ENUM('Publik', 'Khusus Anggota') DEFAULT 'Khusus Anggota',
    download_count INT DEFAULT 0,
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- 5. TABEL PROFIL DETAIL ANGGOTA & NETWORKING DIREKTORI
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_profiles (
    profile_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    headline VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    company VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    position VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    specialization VARCHAR(100) NULL, -- misal: Performance Marketing, PR, Brand Management
    location VARCHAR(100) NULL, -- misal: DKI Jakarta, Surabaya
    phone VARCHAR(50) NULL,
    linkedin_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    bio TEXT NULL,
    avatar_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    membership_tier ENUM('Basic Member', 'Professional Member', 'Executive Member') DEFAULT 'Executive Member',
    membership_expiry DATE NULL,
    open_for_collab BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users_membership(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 6. TABEL RIWAYAT PEMBAYARAN IURAN & TRANSAKSI ANGGOTA
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_payments (
    payment_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    invoice_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'BCA Virtual Account',
    status ENUM('Paid', 'Pending', 'Failed') DEFAULT 'Paid',
    paid_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    receipt_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users_membership(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 7. TABEL SERTIFIKAT ANGGOTA
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS member_certificates (
    certificate_id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    certificate_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    issuer VARCHAR(150) DEFAULT 'APMA Indonesia & BNSP',
    issue_date DATE NOT NULL,
    cpd_points INT DEFAULT 0,
    download_url VARCHAR(255) NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users_membership(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Member Dashboard - APMA Portal</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/all.min.css">
    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #4361ee;
            --primary-dark: #3a0ca3;
            --primary-light: #4cc9f0;
            --secondary: #7209b7;
            --accent: #f72585;
            --bg-body: #f4f6fb;
            --surface: #ffffff;
            --surface-glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
            --border: #e2e8f0;
            --text-dark: #0f172a;
            --text-muted: #64748b;
            --success: #10b981;
            --warning: #f59e0b;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --sidebar-width: 270px;
            --radius-lg: 18px;
            --radius-md: 12px;
            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04);
            --shadow-md: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06);
            --shadow-lg: 0 20px 35px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.1);
        }

        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; }
        body { display: flex; background-color: var(--bg-body); color: var(--text-dark); min-height: 100vh; overflow-x: hidden; }

        /* Sidebar Styles */
        .sidebar {
            width: var(--sidebar-width);
            background: #ffffff;
            height: 100vh;
            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            padding: 2rem 1.25rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
            z-index: 50;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        .brand-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            padding-bottom: 2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        }
        .brand-icon {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--secondary) 100%);
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.3);
        }
        .brand-title {
            font-size: 1.25rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }
        .brand-subtitle {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
        }

        .nav-menu { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.4rem; flex-grow: 1; }
        .nav-category {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            color: #94a3b8;
            margin: 1.2rem 0.75rem 0.4rem;
        }
        .nav-link {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            padding: 0.85rem 1.1rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.25s ease;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .nav-link i { font-size: 1.15rem; width: 22px; text-align: center; }
        .nav-link:hover { background-color: #f1f5f9; color: var(--primary); transform: translateX(3px); }
        .nav-link.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary) 0%, var(--primary-dark) 100%);
            color: #ffffff;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.25);
        }

        .sidebar-footer {
            padding-top: 1.5rem;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .member-mini-card {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            padding: 0.75rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            background: #f8fafc;
        }
        .avatar-sm {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            object-fit: cover;
            border: 2px solid var(--primary);
        }
        .mini-name { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark); }
        .mini-badge { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--success); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
        .mini-badge::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: var(--success); border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }

        /* Main Content Container */
        .main-content {
            margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
            width: calc(100% - var(--sidebar-width));
            padding: 2.2rem 3rem 4rem;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Top Header */
        .top-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 2.2rem;
        }
        .header-title h1 {
            font-size: 1.85rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            letter-spacing: -0.5px;
        }
        .header-title p {
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            margin-top: 0.2rem;
        }
        .header-actions {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
        }
        .tier-badge {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24 0%, #d97706 100%);
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 0.45rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }

        /* Tabs System */
        .tab-panel { display: none; animation: slideUp 0.35s ease forwards; }
        .tab-panel.active { display: block; }
        @keyframes slideUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

        /* Tab 1: Personal Dashboard Grid */
        .personal-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr;
            gap: 2rem;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
        }

        /* 3D Holographic Card */
        .ecard-wrapper {
            perspective: 1000px;
        }
        .hologram-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e1b4b 50%, #311042 100%);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 2.2rem;
            color: #ffffff;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            transition: transform 0.4s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
        }
        .hologram-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px) rotateX(2deg) rotateY(-2deg);
            box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -10px rgba(67, 97, 238, 0.35);
        }
        .hologram-card::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -60%;
            left: -60%;
            width: 220%;
            height: 220%;
            background: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 50%, transparent 60%);
            transform: rotate(25deg);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .card-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .card-logo {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 2.5px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffffff, #93c5fd);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }
        .card-chip {
            width: 46px;
            height: 34px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fef08a 0%, #ca8a04 100%);
            border-radius: 6px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            position: relative;
        }
        .card-chip::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 1px;
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
        }
        .card-mid { margin-bottom: 2rem; position: relative; z-index: 2; }
        .card-holder-name {
            font-size: 1.35rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        }
        .card-headline {
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .card-bottom {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }
        .card-id-box label {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: #94a3b8;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }
        .card-id-number {
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            color: #e2e8f0;
        }
        .card-qr-box {
            background: #ffffff;
            padding: 6px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card-qr-box img { width: 48px; height: 48px; }

        .card-actions-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.75rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
        }

        /* Membership Status Card */
        .membership-status-box {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 1.8rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            margin-top: 1.5rem;
        }
        .status-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }
        .status-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .status-pill {
            background: #dcfce7;
            color: #166534;
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
        }
        .status-pill::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #16a34a; border-radius: 50%; }
        .expiry-tracker {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 1rem;
            background: #f8fafc;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
        }
        .tracker-item span { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; }
        .tracker-item strong { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--text-dark); font-weight: 700; }

        /* Profile Details Card */
        .profile-card {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            padding: 2rem;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .profile-card-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
            padding-bottom: 1rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .profile-card-header h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--text-dark); }
        .btn-edit-profile {
            background: #f1f5f9;
            color: var(--primary);
            border: none;
            padding: 0.55rem 1.1rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
        }
        .btn-edit-profile:hover { background: var(--primary); color: #ffffff; }

        .profile-info-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1.4rem;
        }
        .info-field label {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            color: var(--text-muted);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.25rem;

    <!-- JAVASCRIPT LOGIC -->
    <!-- ============================================================== -->
    <script>
        // Data States
        let currentProfile = {};
        let directoryList = [];
        let resourceList = [];
        let activeResourceCat = 'Semua';

        // Nav Switcher
        function switchNav(tabKey, element) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(link => link.classList.remove('active'));

            const target = document.getElementById('tab-' + tabKey);
            if (target) target.classList.add('active');
            if (element) element.classList.add('active');

            const titles = {
                'personal': { title: 'Dasbor Personal Anggota', subtitle: 'Kelola profil resmi, pantau status keanggotaan, iuran, dan sertifikat profesional Anda.' },
                'directory': { title: 'Direktori Anggota APMA', subtitle: 'Jelajahi dan hubungi praktisi pemasaran terbaik di Indonesia untuk kolaborasi B2B.' },
                'resources': { title: 'Pusat Sumber Daya Eksklusif', subtitle: 'Unduh rekaman webinar, template kontrak hukum agensi, media plan, dan studi kasus industri.' },
                'events': { title: 'Acara & Masterclass Industri', subtitle: 'Ikuti agenda peningkatan kompetensi profesional marketing terakreditasi.' },
                'cpd': { title: 'Continuing Professional Development (CPD)', subtitle: 'Pantau akumulasi poin CPD tahunan Anda untuk akreditasi keanggotaan.' }
            };

            if (titles[tabKey]) {
                document.getElementById('page-heading').textContent = titles[tabKey].title;
                document.getElementById('page-subheading').textContent = titles[tabKey].subtitle;
            }
        }

        // Toast Helper
        function showToast(msg) {
            const toast = document.getElementById('toast-notify');
            document.getElementById('toast-message').textContent = msg;
            toast.classList.add('show');
            setTimeout(() => { toast.classList.remove('show'); }, 3500);
        }

        // --- 1. PROFILE & PERSONAL DASHBOARD ---
        async function loadProfile() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/profile?user_id=1');
                const result = await res.json();
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    currentProfile = result.data;
                    renderProfile(currentProfile);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Load profile error:', err);
            }
        }

        function renderProfile(p) {
            document.getElementById('sidebar-name').textContent = p.full_name || 'Budi Santoso';
            document.getElementById('card-holder-name').textContent = (p.full_name || 'Budi Santoso').toUpperCase();
            document.getElementById('card-headline').textContent = p.headline || p.position || 'Digital Marketing Strategist';
            document.getElementById('card-id-val').textContent = p.member_id_number || 'APMA-2026-0892';
            document.getElementById('header-tier').textContent = p.membership_tier || 'Executive Member';
            document.getElementById('val-tier').textContent = p.membership_tier || 'Executive Member';
            
            document.getElementById('view-fullname').textContent = p.full_name || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-email').textContent = p.email || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-company').textContent = p.company || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-position').textContent = p.position || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-specialization').textContent = p.specialization || 'Performance Marketing';
            document.getElementById('view-location').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot" style="color: var(--danger);"></i> ${p.location || 'DKI Jakarta'}`;
            document.getElementById('view-phone').textContent = p.phone || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-linkedin').textContent = p.linkedin_url || 'https://linkedin.com';
            document.getElementById('view-linkedin').href = p.linkedin_url || 'https://linkedin.com';
            document.getElementById('view-bio').textContent = p.bio || '-';
            
            const collabEl = document.getElementById('view-collab-status');
            if (p.open_for_collab) {
                collabEl.innerHTML = `<span class="collab-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-handshake"></i> Terbuka untuk Kolaborasi B2B & Proyek</span>`;
            } else {
                collabEl.innerHTML = `<span style="font-size: 0.8rem; color: #94a3b8; font-weight: 600;"><i class="fa-solid fa-circle-xmark"></i> Belum Membuka Kolaborasi Baru</span>`;
            }
        }

        function openEditProfileModal() {
            document.getElementById('edit-fullname').value = currentProfile.full_name || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-position').value = currentProfile.position || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-company').value = currentProfile.company || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-specialization').value = currentProfile.specialization || 'Performance Marketing';
            document.getElementById('edit-location').value = currentProfile.location || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-phone').value = currentProfile.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-linkedin').value = currentProfile.linkedin_url || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-bio').value = currentProfile.bio || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-collab').checked = Boolean(currentProfile.open_for_collab);

            document.getElementById('edit-profile-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeEditProfileModal() {
            document.getElementById('edit-profile-modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        async function handleSaveProfile(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const payload = {
                user_id: 1,
                full_name: document.getElementById('edit-fullname').value,
                position: document.getElementById('edit-position').value,
                company: document.getElementById('edit-company').value,
                specialization: document.getElementById('edit-specialization').value,
                location: document.getElementById('edit-location').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('edit-phone').value,
                linkedin_url: document.getElementById('edit-linkedin').value,
                bio: document.getElementById('edit-bio').value,
                open_for_collab: document.getElementById('edit-collab').checked
            };

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/profile', {
                    method: 'PUT',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const result = await res.json();
                if (res.ok) {
                    currentProfile = { ...currentProfile, ...payload };
                    renderProfile(currentProfile);
                    closeEditProfileModal();
                    showToast('Profil Anda berhasil diperbarui!');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                showToast('Profil berhasil disimpan di peramban!');
                currentProfile = { ...currentProfile, ...payload };
                renderProfile(currentProfile);
                closeEditProfileModal();
            }
        }

        function downloadEcard() {
            showToast('Mengunduh E-Card Digital beresolusi tinggi...');
            setTimeout(() => {
                alert('E-Card Digital (APMA-2026-0892.png) siap disimpan ke perangkat Anda.');
            }, 800);
        }

        // --- 2. PAYMENTS & CERTIFICATES ---
        async function loadPayments() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/payments?user_id=1');
                const result = await res.json();
                const tbody = document.getElementById('payments-table-body');
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = result.data.map(item => `
                        <tr>
                            <td><strong style="font-family: monospace; color: var(--primary);">${item.invoice_number}</strong></td>
                            <td>${item.description}</td>
                            <td>${item.paid_at ? item.paid_at.substring(0, 10) : '-'}</td>
                            <td><strong>Rp ${Number(item.amount).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong></td>
                            <td>${item.payment_method}</td>
                            <td><span class="badge-paid"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> ${item.status === 'Paid' ? 'Lunas' : item.status}</span></td>
                            <td>
                                <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="downloadReceipt('${item.invoice_number}')">
                                    <i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Kwitansi
                                </button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    `).join('');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading payments:', err);
            }
        }

        function downloadReceipt(inv) {
            showToast(`Mengunduh Bukti Pembayaran / Invoice ${inv}...`);
        }

        async function loadCertificates() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/certificates?user_id=1');
                const result = await res.json();
                const container = document.getElementById('certificates-grid');
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    container.innerHTML = result.data.map(cert => `
                        <div class="cert-card">
                            <div class="cert-badge-gold"><i class="fa-solid fa-ribbon"></i></div>
                            <div class="cert-title">${cert.title}</div>
                            <div class="cert-meta">
                                <div><strong>No:</strong> ${cert.certificate_number}</div>
                                <div><strong>Penerbit:</strong> ${cert.issuer}</div>
                                <div><strong>Tanggal Terbit:</strong> ${cert.issue_date}</div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="cert-points"><i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i> +${cert.cpd_points} Poin CPD Terakreditasi</div>
                            <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm btn-block" onclick="downloadCert('${cert.certificate_number}')">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Unduh Sertifikat (PDF)
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading certificates:', err);
            }
        }

        function downloadCert(num) {
            showToast(`Mengunduh Berkas Sertifikat Resmi: ${num}...`);
        }

        // --- 3. MEMBER DIRECTORY ---
        async function loadDirectory() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/directory');
                const result = await res.json();
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    directoryList = result.data;
                    renderDirectory(directoryList);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading directory:', err);
            }
        }

        function renderDirectory(list) {
            const container = document.getElementById('directory-grid');
            if (list.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 3rem; color: var(--text-muted);">Tidak ada anggota yang cocok dengan filter pencarian.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = list.map(m => `
                <div class="member-card">
                    <div class="member-card-header">
                        <img src="${m.avatar}" alt="${m.name}" class="member-avatar">
                        <div class="member-main-info">
                            <h4>${m.name}</h4>
                            <p>${m.position} • ${m.company}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    ${m.open_for_collab ? `<span class="collab-badge"><i class="fa-solid fa-handshake"></i> Open for B2B Collab</span>` : ''}
                    <div class="member-bio">${m.bio}</div>
                    <div class="member-tags">
                        <span class="tag-pill"><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot" style="color: var(--danger);"></i> ${m.location}</span>
                        <span class="tag-pill" style="background: #eff6ff; color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700;">${m.specialization}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="member-card-footer">
                        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="flex: 1;" onclick="openMemberDetail(${m.id})"><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> Detail</button>
                        <a href="https://wa.me/${m.phone ? m.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : ''}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" style="flex: 1.2;"><i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Hubungi</a>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function filterDirectory() {
            const q = document.getElementById('dir-search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            const loc = document.getElementById('filter-location').value;
            const spec = document.getElementById('filter-specialization').value;
            const pos = document.getElementById('filter-position').value;
            const collab = document.getElementById('filter-collab').checked;

            let filtered = directoryList.filter(m => {
                const matchQ = m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.company.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.specialization.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.bio.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const matchLoc = loc === 'Semua' || m.location.toLowerCase().includes(loc.toLowerCase());
                const matchSpec = spec === 'Semua' || m.specialization.toLowerCase().includes(spec.toLowerCase());
                const matchPos = pos === 'Semua' || m.position.toLowerCase().includes(pos.toLowerCase());
                const matchCollab = !collab || m.open_for_collab;

                return matchQ && matchLoc && matchSpec && matchPos && matchCollab;
            });

            renderDirectory(filtered);
        }

        function openMemberDetail(id) {
            const m = directoryList.find(item => item.id === id);
            if (!m) return;

            document.getElementById('modal-member-content').innerHTML = `
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 1.2rem; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
                    <img src="${m.avatar}" style="width: 75px; height: 75px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; border: 3px solid var(--primary);">
                    <div>
                        <h4 style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800;">${m.name}</h4>
                        <p style="color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 600;">${m.position} di <strong>${m.company}</strong></p>
                        <span class="badge-specialization" style="margin-top: 6px;">${m.specialization}</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="background: #f8fafc; padding: 1.2rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); margin-bottom: 1.2rem;">
                    <strong style="display: block; font-size: 0.8rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 4px;">Tentang & Latar Belakang</strong>
                    <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-dark);">${m.bio}</p>
                </div>
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
                    <div>
                        <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">Lokasi</span>
                        <p style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-dark);">${m.location}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <span style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--text-muted); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700;">ID Anggota</span>
                        <p style="font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); font-family: monospace;">${m.member_id}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.8rem;">
                    <a href="https://wa.me/${m.phone ? m.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : ''}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-block"><i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Chat WhatsApp B2B</a>
                    <a href="${m.linkedin || '#'}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline btn-block"><i class="fa-brands fa-linkedin"></i> Profil LinkedIn</a>
                </div>
            `;
            document.getElementById('member-detail-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeMemberDetailModal() {
            document.getElementById('member-detail-modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        // --- 4. RESOURCE CENTER ---
        async function loadResources() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/resources');
                const result = await res.json();
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    resourceList = result.data;
                    renderResources(resourceList);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Error loading resources:', err);
            }
        }

        function getCategoryClass(cat) {
            if (cat === 'Webinar Replay') return 'type-webinar';
            if (cat === 'Template Kontrak') return 'type-contract';
            if (cat === 'Brief Kampanye') return 'type-brief';
            return 'type-case';
        }

        function renderResources(list) {
            const container = document.getElementById('resource-grid');
            if (list.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column: 1/-1; text-align: center; padding: 3rem; color: var(--text-muted);">Tidak ada berkas yang sesuai dengan kriteria.</div>`;
                return;
            }

            container.innerHTML = list.map(r => `
                <div class="resource-card">
                    <span class="res-type-pill ${getCategoryClass(r.category)}">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-file"></i> ${r.category}
                    </span>
                    <div class="res-title">${r.title}</div>
                    <div class="res-desc">${r.description}</div>
                    <div class="res-meta-bar">
                        <span><i class="fa-solid fa-database"></i> ${r.file_type} (${r.file_size})</span>
                        <span><i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> ${r.downloads} Unduhan</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="res-actions">
                        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" style="flex: 1;" onclick="previewResource(${r.id})"><i class="fa-solid fa-eye"></i> Pratinjau</button>
                        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" style="flex: 1.2;" onclick="downloadResource(${r.id}, '${r.title.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')"><i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Unduh</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function switchResourceCategory(cat, btn) {
            activeResourceCat = cat;
            document.querySelectorAll('.cat-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');
            filterResources();
        }

        function filterResources() {
            const q = document.getElementById('res-search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            let filtered = resourceList.filter(r => {
                const matchCat = activeResourceCat === 'Semua' || r.category === activeResourceCat;
                const matchQ = r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.author.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                return matchCat && matchQ;
            });
            renderResources(filtered);
        }

        function previewResource(id) {
            const r = resourceList.find(item => item.id === id);
            if (!r) return;

            document.getElementById('preview-res-title').textContent = r.title;
            document.getElementById('preview-res-body').innerHTML = `
                <div style="background: #f1f5f9; padding: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; display: flex; gap: 1.5rem;">
                    <div><strong>Kategori:</strong> ${r.category}</div>
                    <div><strong>Format:</strong> ${r.file_type}</div>
                    <div><strong>Ukuran:</strong> ${r.file_size}</div>
                </div>
                <h4 style="margin-bottom: 0.5rem; color: var(--text-dark);">Ringkasan & Cakupan Berkas:</h4>
                <p style="margin-bottom: 1rem; color: #334155;">${r.description}</p>
                <div style="border-left: 3px solid var(--primary); padding-left: 1rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 0.9rem;">
                    <p><strong>Penyusun:</strong> ${r.author}</p>
                    <p><strong>Status Lisensi:</strong> Hak Akses Eksklusif Anggota Terdaftar APMA (Non-Redistribution).</p>
                </div>
            `;
            document.getElementById('btn-modal-download').onclick = () => downloadResource(r.id, r.title);
            document.getElementById('resource-preview-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeResourcePreviewModal() {
            document.getElementById('resource-preview-modal').classList.remove('active');
        }

        async function downloadResource(id, title) {
            try {
                await fetch(`/api/resources/${id}/download`, { method: 'POST' });
                showToast(`Mengunduh materi: ${title.substring(0, 30)}...`);
                // Update local counter
                const resItem = resourceList.find(item => item.id === id);
                if (resItem) {
                    resItem.downloads += 1;
                    renderResources(resourceList);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
                showToast('Unduhan berkas dimulai!');
            }
        }

        // --- 5. EVENT REGISTRATION ---
        function registerEvent(eventId) {
            fetch('/api/events/register', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify({ event_id: eventId, user_id: 1, payment_status: 'Free' })
            })
            .then(res => res.json())
            .then(data => showToast(data.message || 'Pendaftaran acara berhasil dicatat!'))
            .catch(() => showToast('Pendaftaran sesi berhasil dikonfirmasi!'));
        }

        // Initial Executions
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadProfile();
            loadPayments();
            loadCertificates();
            loadDirectory();
            loadResources();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

+  }
+];
+
+// --- 1. Rute GET /api/events/calendar ---
+app.get('/api/events/calendar', (req, res) => {
+  const { month, category } = req.query;
+  let events = [...mockCalendarEvents];
+
+  if (category && category !== 'Semua') {
+    events = events.filter(e => e.category.toLowerCase() === category.toLowerCase() || e.event_type.toLowerCase().includes(category.toLowerCase()));
+  }
+
+  res.status(200).json({
+    status: 'success',
+    total: events.length,
+    data: events
+  });
+});
+
+// --- 2. Rute POST /api/events/ticket-register ---
+app.post('/api/events/ticket-register', (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { event_id, full_name, email, phone, is_member, member_id } = req.body;
+    const event = mockCalendarEvents.find(e => e.id === Number(event_id));
+
+    if (!event) {
+      return res.status(404).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Acara tidak ditemukan' });
+    }
+
+    const isMemberUser = Boolean(is_member);
+    const calculatedPrice = isMemberUser ? event.member_price : event.non_member_price;
+    const discountAmount = isMemberUser ? (event.non_member_price - event.member_price) : 0;
+    const ticketNumber = `TKT-${event.category.substring(0, 3).toUpperCase()}-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
+
+    // Increment register count
+    event.registered = Math.min(event.quota, event.registered + 1);
+
+    const ticketData = {
+      ticket_number: ticketNumber,
+      event_id: event.id,
+      event_title: event.title,
+      event_date: event.date,
+      event_time: event.time,
+      location: event.location,
+      attendee_name: full_name || 'Peserta Terdaftar',
+      attendee_email: email,
+      attendee_phone: phone,
+      is_member: isMemberUser,
+      member_id: isMemberUser ? (member_id || 'APMA-2026-0892') : null,
+      nominal_paid: calculatedPrice,
+      discount_applied: discountAmount,
+      status: calculatedPrice === 0 ? 'Confirmed / Free Member Ticket' : 'Paid / Confirmed',
+      qr_code: `https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=180x180&data=${ticketNumber}-${encodeURIComponent(full_name || 'Attendee')}`,
+      cpd_points_awarded: isMemberUser ? event.cpd_points : 0,
+      registered_at: new Date().toISOString()
+    };
+
+    res.status(201).json({
+      status: 'success',
+      message: `Pendaftaran berhasil! Tiket elektronik ${ticketNumber} telah diterbitkan.`,
+      data: ticketData
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error ticketing:', error);
+    res.status(500).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Gagal memproses pendaftaran tiket.' });
+  }
+});
+
+// --- 3. Rute GET /api/certifications/programs ---
+app.get('/api/certifications/programs', (req, res) => {
+  res.status(200).json({
+    status: 'success',
+    data: mockCertificationPrograms
+  });
+});
+
+// --- 4. Rute GET /api/certifications/schedules ---
+app.get('/api/certifications/schedules', (req, res) => {
+  res.status(200).json({
+    status: 'success',
+    data: mockExamSchedules
+  });
+});
+
+// --- 5. Rute GET /api/certifications/verify (Validasi Perekrut / HR) ---
+app.get('/api/certifications/verify', (req, res) => {
+  const query = (req.query.query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
+
+  if (!query) {
+    return res.status(200).json({
+      status: 'success',
+      total: mockCertifiedRegistry.length,
+      data: mockCertifiedRegistry
+    });
+  }
+
+  const results = mockCertifiedRegistry.filter(item =>
+    item.cert_id.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
+    item.name.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
+    item.company.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
+    item.credential_title.toLowerCase().includes(query)
+  );
+
+  res.status(200).json({
+    status: 'success',
+    query: query,
+    total: results.length,
+    data: results
+  });
+});
+
+// --- 6. Rute POST /api/certifications/register ---
+app.post('/api/certifications/register', (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const { exam_id, candidate_name, email, phone, member_id, company, position } = req.body;
+    const exam = mockExamSchedules.find(e => e.exam_id === Number(exam_id));
+
+    if (!exam) {
+      return res.status(404).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Jadwal ujian tidak ditemukan' });
+    }
+
+    exam.registered_count = Math.min(exam.quota, exam.registered_count + 1);
+
+    const regNumber = `REG-EXAM-${Date.now().toString().slice(-6)}`;
+
+    res.status(201).json({
+      status: 'success',
+      message: 'Pendaftaran ujian sertifikasi berhasil dicatat! Tim asesor akan memverifikasi berkas portofolio Anda.',
+      data: {
+        registration_number: regNumber,
+        exam_id: exam.exam_id,
+        exam_title: exam.program_title,
+        batch: exam.batch_name,
+        exam_date: exam.exam_date,
+        candidate_name,
+        status: 'Awaiting Document Review'
+      }
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.error('Error cert registration:', error);
+    res.status(500).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Gagal mendaftar ujian sertifikasi.' });
+  }
 });

        .btn-sm { padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; font-size: 0.8rem; }

        /* Modal Styles */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.6);
            backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
            z-index: 100;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }
        .modal-overlay.active { display: flex; animation: fadeIn 0.25s ease; }
        .modal-box {
            background: #ffffff;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

        .form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1.2rem; }

        function switchNav(tabKey, element) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(panel => panel.classList.remove('active'));

        // --- 1. PROFILE & PERSONAL ---
        async function loadProfile() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/members/profile?user_id=1');

                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    currentProfile = result.data;
                    renderProfile(currentProfile);
                }
            } catch (err) { console.warn(err); }

        function renderProfile(p) {
            document.getElementById('sidebar-name').textContent = p.full_name || 'Budi Santoso';
            document.getElementById('card-holder-name').textContent = (p.full_name || 'Budi Santoso').toUpperCase();
            document.getElementById('card-headline').textContent = p.headline || p.position || 'Digital Marketing Strategist';
            document.getElementById('card-id-val').textContent = p.member_id_number || 'APMA-2026-0892';
            document.getElementById('view-fullname').textContent = p.full_name || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-email').textContent = p.email || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-company').textContent = p.company || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-position').textContent = p.position || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-specialization').textContent = p.specialization || 'Performance Marketing';
            document.getElementById('view-location').innerHTML = `<i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot" style="color: var(--danger);"></i> ${p.location || 'DKI Jakarta'}`;
            document.getElementById('view-phone').textContent = p.phone || '-';
            document.getElementById('view-linkedin').textContent = p.linkedin_url || 'https://linkedin.com';
            document.getElementById('view-bio').textContent = p.bio || '-';
        }

        function openEditProfileModal() {
            document.getElementById('edit-fullname').value = currentProfile.full_name || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-position').value = currentProfile.position || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-company').value = currentProfile.company || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-specialization').value = currentProfile.specialization || 'Performance Marketing';
            document.getElementById('edit-location').value = currentProfile.location || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-phone').value = currentProfile.phone || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-linkedin').value = currentProfile.linkedin_url || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-bio').value = currentProfile.bio || '';
            document.getElementById('edit-collab').checked = Boolean(currentProfile.open_for_collab);
            document.getElementById('edit-profile-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeEditProfileModal() { document.getElementById('edit-profile-modal').classList.remove('active'); }

        async function handleSaveProfile(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const payload = {
                user_id: 1,
                full_name: document.getElementById('edit-fullname').value,
                position: document.getElementById('edit-position').value,
                company: document.getElementById('edit-company').value,
                specialization: document.getElementById('edit-specialization').value,
                location: document.getElementById('edit-location').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('edit-phone').value,
                linkedin_url: document.getElementById('edit-linkedin').value,
                bio: document.getElementById('edit-bio').value,
                open_for_collab: document.getElementById('edit-collab').checked
            };

            await fetch('/api/members/profile', {
                method: 'PUT',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(payload)
            });

            currentProfile = { ...currentProfile, ...payload };
            renderProfile(currentProfile);
            closeEditProfileModal();
            showToast('Profil Anda berhasil diperbarui!');
        }

        function downloadEcard() {
            showToast('Mengunduh E-Card Digital (PNG)...');
        }

        async function loadPayments() {
            const res = await fetch('/api/members/payments?user_id=1');
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.data) {
                document.getElementById('payments-table-body').innerHTML = result.data.map(item => `
                    <tr>
                        <td><strong style="font-family: monospace; color: var(--primary);">${item.invoice_number}</strong></td>
                        <td>${item.description}</td>
                        <td>${item.paid_at ? item.paid_at.substring(0, 10) : '-'}</td>
                        <td><strong>Rp ${Number(item.amount).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong></td>
                        <td>${item.payment_method}</td>
                        <td><span class="badge-paid"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> ${item.status === 'Paid' ? 'Lunas' : item.status}</span></td>
                        <td><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick="showToast('Mengunduh Invoice PDF...')"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf"></i> Kwitansi</button></td>
                    </tr>
                `).join('');
            }
        }

        async function loadCertificates() {
            const res = await fetch('/api/members/certificates?user_id=1');
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.data) {
                document.getElementById('certificates-grid').innerHTML = result.data.map(cert => `
                    <div class="cert-card">
                        <div class="cert-badge-gold"><i class="fa-solid fa-ribbon"></i></div>
                        <h4 style="font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; padding-right: 40px;">${cert.title}</h4>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                            <div>No: <strong>${cert.certificate_number}</strong></div>
                            <div>Penerbit: ${cert.issuer}</div>
                            <div>Tanggal: ${cert.issue_date}</div>
                        </div>
                        <button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm btn-block" onclick="showToast('Mengunduh Sertifikat PDF...')">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Unduh Sertifikat
                        </button>
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }
        }

        // --- 2. KALENDER KEGIATAN & TICKETING ---
        async function loadCalendarEvents() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/events/calendar');
                const result = await res.json();
                if (result.status === 'success' && result.data) {
                    calendarEventsList = result.data;
                    renderCalendarGrid(calendarEventsList);
                    renderEventFeed(calendarEventsList);
                }
            } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
        }

        function renderCalendarGrid(events) {
            const container = document.getElementById('calendar-days-container');
            container.innerHTML = calendarMonthData.map(d => {
                const dayEvents = events.filter(e => e.date === d.date);
                const hasEvent = dayEvents.length > 0;

                return `
                    <div class="cal-date-cell ${hasEvent ? 'has-event' : ''}" onclick="selectCalendarDate('${d.date}')">
                        <div>${d.day}</div>
                        ${dayEvents.map(e => `
                            <span class="cal-event-dot" style="background: ${e.badge_color};" title="${e.title}">
                                ${e.category}
                            </span>
                        `).join('')}
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function renderEventFeed(events) {
            const container = document.getElementById('event-feed-container');
            container.innerHTML = events.map(e => `
                <div class="event-item-card">
                    <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start;">
                        <span class="event-pill ${getEventPillClass(e.category)}">
                            <i class="fa-solid fa-calendar-check"></i> ${e.event_type}
                        </span>
                        <span style="font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: #d97706;"><i class="fa-solid fa-star"></i> +${e.cpd_points} Poin CPD</span>
                    </div>
                    <h4 style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">${e.title}</h4>
                    <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 1rem;">${e.description}</p>
                    
                    <div style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                        <div><i class="fa-solid fa-clock"></i> <strong>Waktu:</strong> ${e.date} | ${e.time}</div>
                        <div><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot"></i> <strong>Lokasi:</strong> ${e.location}</div>
                        <div><i class="fa-solid fa-user-tie"></i> <strong>Pembicara:</strong> ${e.speaker}</div>
                    </div>

                    <div class="ticket-price-box">
                        <div>
                            <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">HARGA KHUSUS ANGGOTA</span>
                            <div class="price-member-tag">${e.member_price === 0 ? 'GRATIS' : 'Rp ' + e.member_price.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div style="text-align: right;">
                            <span style="font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-weight: 700;">NON-ANGGOTA</span>
                            <div class="price-nonmember-tag">Rp ${e.non_member_price.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <button class="btn btn-primary btn-block" onclick="openTicketModal(${e.id})">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-ticket"></i> Klaim Tiket Anggota (Gratis/Subsidi)
                    </button>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function getEventPillClass(cat) {
            if (cat === 'Seminar') return 'pill-seminar';
            if (cat === 'Workshop') return 'pill-workshop';
            if (cat === 'Rapat Umum Anggota') return 'pill-rua';
            return 'pill-networking';
        }

        function selectCalendarDate(dateStr) {
            const filtered = calendarEventsList.filter(e => e.date === dateStr);
            if (filtered.length > 0) {
                renderEventFeed(filtered);
                showToast(`Menampilkan kegiatan pada tanggal ${dateStr}`);
            } else {
                renderEventFeed(calendarEventsList);
            }
        }

        function openTicketModal(eventId) {
            const ev = calendarEventsList.find(e => e.id === eventId);
            if (!ev) return;

            document.getElementById('ticket-event-id').value = ev.id;
            document.getElementById('ticket-event-title').textContent = ev.title;
            document.getElementById('ticket-event-datetime').textContent = `📅 ${ev.date} | ⏰ ${ev.time} | 📍 ${ev.location}`;
            document.getElementById('ticket-final-price').textContent = ev.member_price === 0 ? 'GRATIS (100% Subsidi)' : 'Rp ' + ev.member_price.toLocaleString('id-ID');
            document.getElementById('ticket-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeTicketModal() { document.getElementById('ticket-modal').classList.remove('active'); }

        async function handleTicketCheckout(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const payload = {
                event_id: document.getElementById('ticket-event-id').value,
                full_name: document.getElementById('ticket-name').value,
                email: document.getElementById('ticket-email').value,
                phone: document.getElementById('ticket-phone').value,
                is_member: true,
                member_id: currentProfile.member_id_number || 'APMA-2026-0892'
            };

            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/events/ticket-register', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify(payload)
                });
                const result = await res.json();
                if (res.ok && result.data) {
                    closeTicketModal();
                    renderEticket(result.data);
                }
            } catch (err) {
                console.error(err);
            }
        }

        function renderEticket(t) {
            document.getElementById('eticket-card-body').innerHTML = `
                <div class="eticket-header">
                    <div>
                        <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px;">E-TICKET RESMI</div>
                        <div style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; color: #93c5fd; font-family: monospace;">${t.ticket_number}</div>
                    </div>
                    <span style="background: #10b981; color: #fff; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 12px;">TERKONFIRMASI</span>
                </div>
                <h4 style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.8rem; text-align: left;">${t.event_title}</h4>
                <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr; gap: 1rem; text-align: left; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #cbd5e1; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
                    <div>
                        <div><strong>Peserta:</strong> ${t.attendee_name}</div>
                        <div><strong>Waktu:</strong> ${t.event_date} | ${t.event_time}</div>
                        <div><strong>Lokasi:</strong> ${t.location}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div style="text-align: center; background: #ffffff; padding: 8px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-block;">
                        <img src="${t.qr_code}" style="width: 80px; height: 80px;">
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: #94a3b8; text-align: left; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); padding-top: 0.8rem;">
                    Tunjukkan QR Code ini pada meja registrasi / link verifikasi presensi acara.
                </div>
            `;
            document.getElementById('eticket-success-modal').classList.add('active');
        }

        function closeEticketModal() { document.getElementById('eticket-success-modal').classList.remove('active'); }
        function printTicket() { showToast('Mengunduh Berkas E-Ticket (PDF)...'); }

        // --- 3. SERTIFIKASI PROFESI TAB ---
        async function loadCertPrograms() {
            try {
                const res = await fetch('/api/certifications/programs');
                const result = await res.json();
                if (result.data) {
                    document.getElementById('cert-programs-member-container').innerHTML = result.data.map(p => `
                        <div class="cert-prog-card">
                            <span style="background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 800; padding: 0.25rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 6px; align-self: flex-start; margin-bottom: 0.8rem;">
                                ${p.level}
                            </span>
                            <h4 style="font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">${p.title}</h4>
                            <p style="font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 1.2rem; flex-grow: 1;">${p.description}</p>
                            
                            <div style="background: #f8fafc; padding: 1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); margin-bottom: 1.2rem;">
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.85rem;">
                                    <span>Biaya Anggota:</span>
                                    <strong style="color: var(--success);">${p.price_member === 0 ? 'GRATIS (100% Subsidi)' : 'Rp ' + p.price_member.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</strong>
                                </div>
                                <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-top: 4px;">
                                    <span>Biaya Reguler:</span>
                                    <span>Rp ${p.price_non_member.toLocaleString('id-ID')}</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <a href="certification.html" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline btn-block">
                                <i class="fa-solid fa-graduation-cap"></i> Lihat Jadwal & Daftar Ujian
                            </a>
                        </div>
                    `).join('');
                }
            } catch (err) { console.error(err); }
        }

        // --- 4. DIRECTORY & RESOURCES ---
        async function loadDirectory() {
            const res = await fetch('/api/members/directory');
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.data) {
                directoryList = result.data;
                renderDirectory(directoryList);
            }
        }

        function renderDirectory(list) {
            document.getElementById('directory-grid').innerHTML = list.map(m => `
                <div class="member-card">
                    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 1rem;">
                        <img src="${m.avatar}" class="member-avatar">
                        <div>
                            <h4 style="font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 800;">${m.name}</h4>
                            <p style="font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--text-muted);">${m.position} • ${m.company}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    ${m.open_for_collab ? `<span class="collab-badge" style="margin-bottom: 0.8rem;"><i class="fa-solid fa-handshake"></i> Open for Collab</span>` : ''}
                    <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 1rem; flex-grow: 1;">${m.bio}</p>
                    <a href="https://wa.me/${m.phone ? m.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '') : ''}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-primary btn-sm btn-block">
                        <i class="fa-brands fa-whatsapp"></i> Hubungi B2B
                    </a>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function filterDirectory() {
            const q = document.getElementById('dir-search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            const loc = document.getElementById('filter-location').value;
            const spec = document.getElementById('filter-specialization').value;
            const pos = document.getElementById('filter-position').value;
            const collab = document.getElementById('filter-collab').checked;

            let filtered = directoryList.filter(m => {
                const matchQ = m.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.company.toLowerCase().includes(q) || m.specialization.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                const matchLoc = loc === 'Semua' || m.location.includes(loc);
                const matchSpec = spec === 'Semua' || m.specialization.includes(spec);
                const matchPos = pos === 'Semua' || m.position.includes(pos);
                const matchCollab = !collab || m.open_for_collab;
                return matchQ && matchLoc && matchSpec && matchPos && matchCollab;
            });
            renderDirectory(filtered);
        }

        async function loadResources() {
            const res = await fetch('/api/resources');
            const result = await res.json();
            if (result.data) {
                resourceList = result.data;
                renderResources(resourceList);
            }
        }

        function renderResources(list) {
            document.getElementById('resource-grid').innerHTML = list.map(r => `
                <div class="resource-card">
                    <span class="res-type-pill type-contract">${r.category}</span>
                    <h4 style="font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">${r.title}</h4>
                    <p style="font-size: 0.86rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin-bottom: 1.2rem; flex-grow: 1;">${r.description}</p>
                    <button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm btn-block" onclick="showToast('Mengunduh materi: ${r.title.substring(0, 20)}...')">
                        <i class="fa-solid fa-download"></i> Unduh Berkas (${r.file_type})
                    </button>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }

        function switchResourceCategory(cat, btn) {
            activeResourceCat = cat;
            document.querySelectorAll('.cat-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            btn.classList.add('active');
            filterResources();
        }

        function filterResources() {
            const q = document.getElementById('res-search-input').value.toLowerCase();
            let filtered = resourceList.filter(r => {
                const matchCat = activeResourceCat === 'Semua' || r.category === activeResourceCat;
                const matchQ = r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.description.toLowerCase().includes(q);
                return matchCat && matchQ;
            });
            renderResources(filtered);
        }

        function prevMonth() { showToast('Menampilkan Agustus 2026'); }
        function nextMonth() { showToast('Menampilkan Oktober 2026'); }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadProfile();
            loadPayments();
            loadCertificates();
            loadCalendarEvents();
            loadCertPrograms();
            loadDirectory();
            loadResources();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

1: # Product Requirement Document (PRD): Web APMA (Asosiasi Profesi Marketing Asuransi)
2: 
3: **Versi:** 1.0.0  
4: **Tanggal:** 25 Agustus 2026  
5: **Status:** Draf Final / Berdasarkan Implementasi Kode  
6: **Teknologi Utama:** Node.js (Express.js), MySQL (`mysql2/promise`), Multer, Bcrypt, Nodemailer, Vanilla HTML5/CSS3 (Plus Jakarta Sans)
7: 
8: ---
9: 
10: ## 1. Ringkasan Eksekutif & Visi Produk
11: 
12: ### 1.1 Visi Produk
13: Web **APMA (Asosiasi Profesi Marketing Asuransi)** dirancang sebagai platform digital terpusat untuk memperkuat profesionalisme pemasar asuransi umum di Indonesia. Platform ini memfasilitasi pendaftaran keanggotaan, manajemen lisensi & sertifikasi, pengolahan berita/pengumuman (CMS), pusat dokumen & regulasi, serta pendaftaran acara/webinar.
14: 
15: ### 1.2 Tujuan Utama
16: 1. **Digitalisasi Pendaftaran Anggota:** Memudahkan pendaftaran mandiri calon anggota dan input langsung oleh Admin dengan penomoran otomatis (`APMA-YYYY-XXXX`).
17: 2. **Otomatisasi Credential & Notifikasi:** Menghasilkan nomor anggota, hashing kata sandi sementara secara aman, pencatatan log audit sistem, serta pengiriman email sambutan HTML via Nodemailer.
18: 3. **Pusat Informasi & Unduhan Terkontrol:** Menyediakan repositori regulasi dan materi edukasi dengan pembagian hak akses (Publik vs Khusus Anggota).
19: 4. **Manajemen Acara & Sertifikasi:** Memfasilitasi pendaftaran event/webinar/pelatihan serta pemantauan status keanggotaan dan sertifikasi.
20: 
21: ---
22: 
23: ## 2. Pengguna Target & Peran (User Roles)
24: 
25: | Peran Pengguna | Deskripsi | Hak Akses Utamanya |
26: |---|---|---|
27: | **Pengunjung / Publik** | Calon anggota atau praktisi industri asuransi yang mengakses web publik. | Viewing landing page, membaca berita/pengumuman publik, melihat agenda acara, mengunduh dokumen publik, mendaftar keanggotaan. |
28: | **Anggota (Member)** | Pemegang lisensi/sertifikasi yang terdaftar di APMA. | Mengakses **Portal Anggota**, melihat profil & nomor ID keanggotaan, memantau status sertifikasi, mengunduh dokumen khusus anggota, mendaftar event/webinar. |
29: | **Administrator (Admin)** | Pengelola sistem dan pengurus asosiasi. | Mengakses **Admin Center**, memantau statistik platform, mempublikasikan berita/CMS, membuat acara baru, mengunggah dokumen regulasi, dan menambahi anggota baru secara manual. |
30: 
31: ---
32: 
33: ## 3. Fitur & Modul Fungsional
34: 
35: ### Modul 1: Web Publik & Landing Page (`index.html`)
36: - **Navigasi Utama:** Beranda, Tentang Kami, Keanggotaan, Pusat Informasi, Berita, Kontak, dan Portal Anggota.
37: - **Hero & Call to Action (CTA):** Informasi keunggulan APMA dengan tombol pendaftaran anggota.
38: - **Berita & Pengumuman:** Menampilkan daftar artikel & pengumuman terbaru (`/api/news`).
39: - **Pusat Unduhan Publik:** Akses dokumen publik bagi pengunjung biasa (`/api/downloads?isLoggedIn=false`).
40: 
41: ### Modul 2: Pendaftaran Anggota & Otomatisasi (`public_register.html`, `admin_add_member.html`, `onAfterAdminInsertMember.js`)
42: - **Pendaftaran Mandiri (Public Registration):**
43:   - Form data pribadi: Nama Lengkap, Email, Nomor HP, Perusahaan Asuransi, Tingkat Sertifikasi (Dasar / Madya / Utama).
44:   - Upload dokumen persyaratan (Format: JPG, PNG, PDF, Maks: 2MB).
45: - **Penambahan Anggota oleh Admin (Direct Admin Insert):**
46:   - Endpoint `POST /api/admin/add-member`.
47:   - **Triggers Logic (`onAfterAdminInsertMember`):**
48:     1. **Format Penomoran Anggota:** Otomatis menghasilkan `APMA-2026-XXXX` (padding 4 digit).
49:     2. **Hashing Password:** Password sementara `ApmaSecure2026!` di-hash menggunakan `bcrypt` (salt rounds: 10).
50:     3. **System Logging:** Mencatat aksi `INSERT_NEW_MEMBER` ke log sistem dengan aktor admin penginput.
51:     4. **Email Notification:** Mengirimkan email HTML sambutan berisi Nomor Anggota dan Kata Sandi Sementara via `Nodemailer`.
52: 
53: ### Modul 3: Portal Anggota (`member_dashboard.html`)
54: - **Kartu Profil & Status Anggota:** Menampilkan Nama, Nomor Anggota (`APMA-2026-XXXX`), Status (`Active` / `Pending` / `Suspended`), dan Tanggal Masuk.
55: - **Status Lisensi & Sertifikasi:** Menampilkan masa berlaku lisensi (misal: *LSMU - Level Madya*) dan tombol perpanjangan.
56: - **Keterlibatan Acara (Event Enrolled):** Daftar webinar/workshop yang sedang dan telah diikuti.
57: - **Pusat Unduhan Anggota:** Akses eksklusif dokumen internal/regulasi (`/api/downloads?isLoggedIn=true`).
58: 
59: ### Modul 4: Pusat Kontrol Admin (`admin_dashboard.html`)
60: - **Dashboard Statistik:**
61:   - Total Anggota Terdaftar (misal: 1,248)
62:   - Total Berita Dipublikasi (misal: 34)
63:   - Agenda Acara Mendatang (misal: 5)
64: - **Form Pengelolaan Konten (CMS):**
65:   - **Tambah Berita:** Judul, Kategori (`Berita Asosiasi`, `Artikel`, `Pengumuman Resmi`), Konten (`POST /api/news`).
66:   - **Tambah Agenda Acara:** Judul Acara, Deskripsi, Tipe (`Webinar`, `Sertifikasi`, `Rapat Anggota`, `Workshop`), Tanggal, Waktu, Lokasi/Link Zoom (`POST /api/events`).
67:   - **Unggah Dokumen:** Judul Dokumen, Tingkat Akses (`Publik`, `Khusus Anggota`), File Dokumen (`POST /api/downloads`).
68: 
69: ---
70:
